new uncharged review or a creative approval.
From the October 17 edition, test the first chronological page before full guide traversal on
each new phone or final image-only assignment. A missing probe returns its literal error,
exact identity and partial coverage immediately, without a score or further image reads.
Successful access still requires every full guide, chronological page and timed observation.

Each worker also returns its separate `dispatch_claude_image_coverage/1` object following the
packet's contract. Save that actual response unchanged and run:

```sh
python scripts/claude_runtime.py verify-images --packet <exact worker packet> --coverage <retained coverage JSON> --out <coverage verification JSON>
```

Require complete coverage before accepting a Claude image-only phone pass or final scorer handback. The check
binds the packet, every index/page byte, chronological page identities and retained concrete
observations. It never supplies a finding, score or approval. Retain partial reports and
failed coverage checks exactly; their missing images are access failures, not invented film
defects. Fund the complete remaining path and reserve the same worker's bounded content
follow-up autonomously; never end with a request to choose between charging and waiting.
Keep coverage objects and verification receipts with current review evidence in the
checkpoint and public-safe metadata archive. Coverage verification starts no worker. Image
extraction keeps its prepaid capture charge; every actual content follow-up remains reserved
before execution. A known host
image delivery failure uses this small-read path first, without inventing provider unavailability.

If the actual single-image attempt still returns exactly `[media removed: request limit]`, retain
that observed host media-limit error, the original charged role reservation, and `media_probe`
references for the exact image, packet, failed coverage and corrected full handback. Each reference
has path and SHA256; set `single_image_read: true` and `media_received: false`, and preserve the
literal error as both `error` and `raw_error`. Do not rename it to a different capacity error.
The configured independent transport admits this precise case only with the real owned bytes,
the current single-read packet and an actual unseen-page coverage entry. Artistic rejection,
a missing file, a resource boundary and an untested bulk read do not qualify. No more native
content retries are needed after this observed single-image delivery failure.

Use the deterministic preparation command to bind the latest actual native role reservation
and existing evidence. It records the observed failure and starts no new worker or provider:

```sh
python scripts/independent_review.py --prepare-media-limit --role phone --board out/dispatch/storyboard.json --claims out/dispatch/claims.json --state out/dispatch/run_state.json --actor <actual failed worker id> --source-packet <original failed packet> --coverage <actual failed coverage JSON> --handback <original corrected handback> --probe-image <actual stripped PNG> --compare-openings --out <new failure JSON>
```

For the initial comparison, use the existing provider under its ordinary charged transport:

```sh
python scripts/independent_review.py --role phone --board out/dispatch/storyboard.json --claims out/dispatch/claims.json --failure <retained transport failure JSON> --state out/dispatch/run_state.json --compare-openings --selection-out out/dispatch/openings/selection.json --out out/dispatch/provider-phone-report.json
```

This attaches BOTH exact movies and both complete boards, the actual source evidence and full
current guides. The provider independently chooses a or b and returns separate complete phone
reports for both. The transport projects the selected original report and selection mechanically;
it changes no verdict, score, finding or chosen option. Verify both artifacts with
`independent_review.py --verify <artifact.json>`, then stage the chosen original board/movie and
apply the existing phone gates. A provider rejection remains a rejection and uses normal funded
mandatory repair. Cached comparison media cannot be repurchased by changing labels or guide prose.
The actual direct-video provider response and its verified provenance replace the unavailable
Claude image-access receipt; all seven observations, source, rights, native, audio, caption and
shipment gates remain. Later timed-phone and final-role fallback use the ordinary exact-film
transport only after their own observed assigned-host failure. Keep three separate final scorer
responses and their actual atomic panel charges. Preserve the primary model and saved schedule.

For an observed provider HTTP 402 with no response or verdict, use the restored-generation
procedure in prompts/phases/review-availability.md after external service recovery. Retain the
original request and charge. No billing purchase or completed-verdict retry is authorized.

For current provider inputs use config/independent_packet_compaction.json. Run artifacts are
lossless structured JSON; complete treatment documents may be encoded as checked JSON-pointer
deltas against the complete common board. Preserve original byte hashes and verify reconstruction
before sending. Current guides stay original full text, source evidence and receipts stay complete,
and all unique media stays attached. For pixel review, only registered inactive episode source
outside every selected executable closure may become a hash inventory. Code review retains full
callable source. At phone pixel scope, source bodies may become exact hash inventories only after
the ordinary code gate verifies actual independent code-plan passes for every current board and
both treatments against current concepts, renderer bytes and claims. Carry those complete original
reports into the phone packet. Missing or stale code approval keeps the full source. Those code
passes supply no pixel observation, selection or film approval. Full boards, source evidence and
guides remain. The complete episode registry is structured JSON with every field, its original
byte hash and all entries retained. Use compact JSON whitespace on the wire. The same text-size ceiling is enforced on
the final request after comparison context and retained failure evidence are added. No new provider
charge begins on an oversized input. Historical packets retain their original contents and policy.

The prelaunch `image_read_receipt.py` PostToolUse observer records only actual returned image
payload metadata for the selected repository's owned PNG evidence. Its small immutable receipts
preserve the source and returned hashes without copying image bytes or private transcripts.
They prove tool output, not model visibility or a creative pass. A later context placeholder
cannot by itself rewrite an earlier successful access observation. Preserve each immediate
visibility note and distinguish later context loss from a newly failed Read. A genuinely unseen
new image still requires the exact partial handback and configured recovery. This observer changes
no capture admission, budget, host permissions or shipment gate. Register it only at fresh prelaunch.

The Read-only Opus phone critic cannot play MP4s or compute missing hashes with Bash.
One midpoint still per scene cannot prove timed motion or continuity. After both structural
opening inspections pass, extract the complete chronological sequence from each exact encoded
270 by 480 preview with `claude_motion_review.py --phone-option a` and then `--phone-option b`.
For each option use its canonical `--board out/dispatch/openings/a.json` and matching
`--film out/dispatch/openings/a.mp4` (or b), `--state out/dispatch/run_state.json`, and a fresh
`--out out/dispatch/openings/motion-a` (or b). Use the ordinary wrapped capture authorization
only after checking that output. Reuse an existing complete sequence when --verify accepts the
exact current board and film; otherwise retain the entire previous directory under an unused
edition-evidence path before preparing a fresh extraction. Occupied output is refused before
charging. Preserve partial/failed pages and original indices; never overwrite them. Then authorize
with `--prepare` and that exact board/command. Each extraction reserves one preflight before
decoding, and claims its consumed authorization once without another charge. Headroom,
housekeeping, authored art and all hook protections still apply. Never use the native final
profile on a phone movie or present a phone index as final native evidence.

Build the normal current `daily_production.py --packet storyboard-critic` packet, then:

```sh
python scripts/claude_runtime.py phone-packet --packet out/dispatch/critic-packet.json --state out/dispatch/run_state.json --sequence-a out/dispatch/openings/motion-a/index.json --sequence-b out/dispatch/openings/motion-b/index.json --out out/dispatch/phone-critic-packet.json
```

Plan the existing storyboard critic with that packet and an explicit phone scope. The planner
refuses missing, changed or incomplete movie-derived imagery and computes the report bindings
before the paid call. The critic reads every chronological page for both options and returns
its independent selection and exact-phone report as JSON in the handback. The director saves
the actual response unchanged; Read-only leaves cannot write files. No extraction or mechanical
hash supplies a creative verdict. Missing observed actions stay unresolved. Retain an earlier
sparse-image response and charge a content follow-up before executing it; it is not a free
formatting call or a provider-unavailability event.

After measured narration changes the board and preview timing, use the same authorized extractor
with `--phone-option current --board out/dispatch/storyboard.json --film out/dispatch/preflight.mp4`
and a fresh output directory. It requires the current exact `preflight.json` inspection, edition,
board, renderer and movie bytes. It honors only the existing structural release policy; extraction
still supplies no verdict. Its separate operation reserves and claims once. Build a fresh ordinary
critic packet, then use `claude_runtime.py phone-packet --sequence-current <new index.json>` instead
of the two comparison sequence flags. Keep the same packet, state and output arguments. This
single-film packet binds the measured current board and film, returns a fresh exact-phone report,
and does not choose the silent treatment again. The silent comparison index cannot prove the
timed movie; neither phone profile can satisfy the native final profile. Inspect all chronological
pages, consolidate one handback and recheck only specific uncertain intervals. Report unresolved
observations directly instead of repeatedly viewing the film to pursue approval.

A cloud session has no desktop for Computer Use. Use `scripts/phone_playback.py`, real Chromium UI
automation at 390x844 with touch input, against the published canonical URL:

```sh
python scripts/phone_playback.py --edition-id <id> --film-sha256 <reviewed master sha256> --out-dir out/dispatch/phone
```

It taps the page's own Play control (pause, then play again), taps "tap for sound", samples
currentSrc, currentTime, readyState, paused, muted and error while the clock runs, records whether
the page received trusted input events, hashes the published master and phone bytes, and saves
hashed screenshots. Its `tool` field says browser automation, not Computer Use. Put its
`phone_playback.json` in the shipment manifest unchanged. `shipment_check.py` applies every
historical assertion plus `claude_playback_problems`. The Codex Computer Use route and its evidence
format stay valid. Never fabricate observations. If the page, media or browser fails, production
stays active and the real failure is recorded.

## Haiku mechanical route (future editions only)

Effective for editions from the date in `mechanical_route.effective_from` in `config/claude_runtime.json`.
One graded trial showed Haiku at high effort can diagnose and mechanically repair a caption layout gate when
the case is strictly specified. The route admits only that shape of work and refuses everything else, which
leaves the unchanged Opus assignment. Its evidence is `runs/2026-10-11/experiments/haiku-calibration-1`,
including the trial limitations, and it supports no wider claim.

- Two tasks only. `code-only-review` runs the storyboard critic read only on named gate tests.
  `mechanical-correction` runs the scene builder on named gate tests with one failing case, named acceptance
  results, named unchanged controls and named mutation checks.
- Only gate tests are in scope: files under `video-engine/tests/` and `scripts/*_test.py`. Renderer source,
  art, story, claims, config, prompts, ledgers and every run path are refused, as is the initial authored build.
  The three final scorers, the validator, the researcher and the voice director never use this route.
- The packet stays the normal complete hash-bound role packet with every current guide. Add a `mechanical`
  object to it before planning, naming the task, the exact existing files as `{path, sha256}` pairs and the required fields, and keep expected
  findings out of the packet. The scope text may name only those files, and a correction's named results,
  controls and mutation checks are non-empty lists of names. Plan with `python scripts/claude_runtime.py plan ... --mechanical-task <task>`.
  An admitted plan adds only the Haiku spawn model and effort. The role, brief, packet and controller resource
  are the unchanged ones, so reservations, charges and every gate are unchanged. A refusal is not an error to
  work around. Plan the same task without the flag.
- A Haiku result is never a verdict. Re run the named results, controls and mutation checks yourself, record the
  actual agent identity, requested effort and observed usage, keep observed effort and billing unknown where
  the host omits them, and let an Opus or Sonnet reviewer judge anything rendered.

## Capture authorization

For a multi-repository cloud session, the environment setup registers the capture hook at its
actual primary workspace before launch with
`python scripts/bootstrap_claude_hooks.py --workspace /home/user --prelaunch-router`.
The preinstalled router selects the actual production checkout from the command's explicit
working directory, including restored checkouts, and runs the unchanged authorization gate.
Never replace this registration during an agent turn. The helper preserves model, effort,
environment, permissions and unrelated hooks. It replaces only its own earlier registration and
points the handler at the active checkout, whose ledger and assets the handler verifies. This is
registration, never proof that the host loaded it and never capture authorization. Keep the actual
native denial of the harmless capture-form probe before a real capture. If the host has not loaded
the registration, retain that observation and restart from the durable checkpoint using the supported
routine launch; do not replay synthetic PreToolUse events as a substitute or weaken auto mode.
If the host denies registration, preserve the denial and apply the same versioned registration in
the authorized environment setup before the next supported launch rather than retrying a denied edit.

Every native capture or render command (Remotion stills and renders, preflight, opening compare, cinema proof,
render_dispatch) is denied by the PreToolUse hook `scripts/capture_guard.py hook` unless the director has
issued a current authorization for that exact command. Use the prepared operator handoff below for
the supported operators. It checks occupied output before charging, then binds one fresh render
reservation to the exact boards and command. A late-accounting charge never counts.

```sh
python scripts/capture_guard.py authorize --prepare --state out/dispatch/run_state.json --board out/dispatch/opening-a.json --board out/dispatch/opening-b.json --command "bash scripts/run_with_env.sh python scripts/opening_compare.py --root out/dispatch --state out/dispatch/run_state.json"
```

For `opening_compare.py`, `preflight_animatic.py`, `cinema_proof.py` and `claude_motion_review.py`, use the
prepared operator handoff instead of manually reserving a note and letting the operator reserve
again. `authorize --prepare` derives the operation from the exact checkout command, checks the
same art, headroom and housekeeping gates, then charges it once. The real host hook consumes
the exact authorization, and that operator claims its matching prepaid event once. A phone
preview cannot claim a native hero charge; motion extraction has its own exact-film identity.
An unchanged operation cannot be prepared again without the existing infrastructure-retry record.
Preserve all earlier charges and denied commands.
Before a changed comparison, retain the entire occupied `openings/` directory, including any
partial output, in the edition's defect package. Do this before preparing the new capture. Never
overwrite it, refund its reservation or rerender an unchanged pair merely to obtain a new identity.
Do not create a self-written failure note or request `retry-preflight` to correct an operation
label. Fix the actual versioned operator handoff and retain its before/after source evidence.

For an actual execution or transport failure after hook consumption, retain the original tool
response, spent authorization and reservation. Once the concrete infrastructure fix or supported
specific approval is available, follow prompts/phases/repair.md and record `retry-preflight` for
that exact operation using the actual failure log. Fund the complete remaining path first, then
prepare a fresh charged authorization. Never replay the spent one or refund the failed attempt.

```sh
python scripts/capture_guard.py authorize --prepare --state out/dispatch/run_state.json --board out/dispatch/storyboard.json --command "bash scripts/run_with_env.sh python scripts/cinema_proof.py --board out/dispatch/storyboard.json --mix out/dispatch/mix.wav --state out/dispatch/run_state.json"
```

It writes `out/dispatch/capture-authorization.json` only from facts: an unused fresh charged render reservation,
passed native headroom, portable housekeeping run with `--apply --fetch --summary --require-headroom` and the
computed minimum (its receipt is kept), and genuine recorded authored receipts. The authorization is bound to the
exact board, renderer and art hashes and to the listed commands. The hook rechecks them and current headroom,
denies unreadable, unresolved or unrelated --props and --board inputs and placeholder art, and consumes each
authorized command once, so the next capture needs a new reservation. Builders never capture. Before the first
real capture of a run, prove the hook is active with a harmless capture-form command that must be denied,
and keep that denial as evidence.

# Direct a world before building a scene

Teaching sources: [Pixar's cinematography account](https://renderman.pixar.com/stories/incredible-cinematography)
for coordinated staging, light and camera; [OpenAI evaluation practices](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices)
for reference calibration, pairwise comparison and order bias. Current filmed evidence decides
which choices work here.

Read this with the viewer method, selected approach dossier, fixed quality contract and
current rubric. It adds executable craft inputs and calibration, not a score, quota,
new judge or extra paid attempt. Existing source, rights, action, native, audio, captions,
cumulative resources, finite artistic recovery and shipment requirements continue.

## Director

Before coding, choose the visual approach from actual source access. Think through four
lenses in the existing director assignment: the comedian finds an observable mismatch;
the dramatist finds pressure and a changed state; the explainer finds the causal relation;
the enthusiast finds a specific surprising detail. Do not invent a joke, conflict or
outcome. Choose exactly two complete treatments within the current comparison allowance.

Write `art_direction` in each board using `config/art_direction.json`. Explain seven palette
roles, contrasting shapes, the recognizable hero silhouette and its finish, motivated
light, focal hierarchy, action timing, and one signature shot tied to an actual event.
Name the current asset and actual subject ids. Use the source image itself when it is the
hero. Give a dimensional scene a `shots[scene_id]` camera position, target, lens and reason;
an event-bound `to` pose is optional. For the illustrated carton route, use `flat_shots`
with native-coordinate offsets, scale and a reason. Numeric shot choices must be executed
by the routed scene, not left as board prose. A custom renderer must consume the same
profile or explain its retained source lighting and implement its relevant choices.

The focal object stays sharp. Depth blur must arise from actual separation and preserve
contact detail. Never add blur, floating shapes, lens flares, camera kicks or orbiting as
automatic cinematic decoration. Hold the camera while an object performs. Move it to reveal
a relation or follow a finite action. Give a completed result a comprehension hold.

## Scene builder and render owner

Use `prompts/roles/scene-builder.md` in the existing code assignment. Build the finished
hero first, then light and stage it before extending the scene. Recognizable geometry,
edges, seams, hardware, texture and grounded shadows beat a field of placeholder primitives.
Authored 2.5D, useful footage and a readable source image can outperform complicated 3D.
Do not restrict the daily story to the demonstration subject or copy reference b-roll.

The shared `ArtDirectionProvider` carries current choices in both entry points. Three.js
`CinematicStage`/`Studio` execute the light recipe and exposure. `directedShot` executes
authored event-bound cameras. The illustrated carton component executes its flat framing,
finished surfaces, occlusion and contact assemblies. Source footage retains original speed
and practical lighting. Existing boards without this profile retain their original defaults.

Every new event specifies a motion curve within its existing measured window: `travel`
accelerates and brakes; `contact` approaches and settles; `linear` serves constant-speed
movement; `smoothstep` is available for a justified gentle transition. `anticipation` and
`settle` reserve fractions inside that window, never new runtime or voice stretching.
`landing` has a small overshoot and needs a free-prop reason; never use it for a constrained
contact, a foot planted on ground, or a source-implied machine limit. Check music and foley
against the executed contact, not the old curve. No incidental sway substitutes for action.

Judge motion at the delivered 30 fps. A regular frame clock does not excuse abrupt starts,
fast screen-space travel or repeated stop-and-go strokes. Directed `travel` and `contact`
curves start and finish with zero velocity and acceleration. Give a heavy load enough of
the existing scene window to accelerate and brake. Holds consume that window; do not squeeze
the entire stroke into the remaining few frames. Inspect velocity at event joins as well
as the start and end. Keep a clear contact view and a stable camera when tracking amplifies
the load's movement. Do not conceal stepping with blur, frame interpolation or faster audio.
An event-bound moving camera uses `travel` or `contact`; the input check refuses constant-speed
starts and landing overshoot on a camera. Hold it when the object needs a different curve.

When two named events describe successive stages of one uninterrupted movement, author
adjacent windows with no interior anticipation or settle, then explicitly use
`joinedActionWindow`. The helper rejects gaps, scene boundaries and erased rests. The
illustrated carton route consumes `continuous_withdrawal_event_ids` only in its withdrawal
scene. Retiming a movement keeps the source relation, scene runtime and measured captions.

## Existing independent critic and three scorers

Watch the actual muted sequence first. Name the object, action, changed state and answered
question before reading the profile. Then test whether its choices are visible: compare
silhouette, contact, surface finish, hierarchy, framing, rhythm and hold at phone size and
native crop scale. Inspect the beginning, contact and end of every action. Keep narration
and labels covered on the first pass. A good explanation in the profile cannot clear an
occluded grip, generic slab, unrecognizable subject or absent transformation.

Watch uninterrupted playback at normal speed. Check for velocity jumps, stop-and-go camera
tracking, repeated frames during movement and excessively large per-frame displacement.
Separate deliberate shot cuts and completed holds from a continuous stroke that stutters.
Record the exact interval and affected object or camera. Smooth motion is a visible property,
not a consequence of a passing score or a high frame rate.

Read `knowledge/craft/cinematic_reference_bank.json`. Its frozen passages teach specific
decisions; their old scores use different rubrics and are not comparable ratings. They are
references, never production assets or current approval. Compare two current complete cuts,
describe a preference with exact times, then record mandatory defects under the existing
criteria. A different palette preference alone does not create another correction. Retain
all original rejections. At the configured artistic boundary, finish the strongest credible
cut; source, comprehension and technical failures still take the mandatory recovery route.

## Learn from shipped and failed footage

`scripts/cinematic_learning.py` records the next five editions from the policy's effective
date, including unfinished editions, first-panel success, scores, all actual resource usage,
provider tokens, elapsed time, correction counts and artistic deferrals. Unknown account
tokens remain null. Do not claim future results or a numerical improvement multiplier.

After durable shipment, refresh the report and the recurring-defect packet from the last
fourteen days. At most once per seven days, give the existing builder a fresh compact packet:
up to five recurring findings, exact rejected evidence and one proposed shared capability.
Reproduce the failed interval; add a useful regression; prove the correction inside the next
edition's already reserved two-treatment comparison. Mark the actual advance or honest skip
in the packet. This is one shared engineering advance, not five new stylistic attempts.
Fund the entire remaining production/review/delivery path before changing the renderer.
Do not delay an accepted cut for optional engineering or add roles, reviews or resource grants.

# Existing scene-builder assignment

Read the current compact packet, actual source limits, selected approach and ART_DIRECTION.md.
You implement the director's two treatments in the existing reserved code task. Keep the
primary model and number of assignments. A fresh packet avoids importing the director's
defense of a weak shot; it does not create an additional daily worker.

Make the hero recognizable and finished before adding a world around it. Execute the palette,
light, framing and motion inputs. Name the actual renderer consumers in your handoff. Prefer
the simplest medium that performs the source-backed action. Do not borrow old film assets.
Keep all contact and consequence readable above the caption band. Test random-access frames
and measured retiming: no accumulating animation state, wall clock or voice stretching.
Inspect full-speed movement at the delivered frame rate. Use continuous acceleration and
braking for heavy loads and motivated cameras; keep one uninterrupted stroke continuous
across its named events. Check the event joins, not just still frames. If travel looks like
stepping, reduce screen-space speed within the existing runtime and hold the camera where
the action remains readable. Blur does not repair a timing fault.

Return the actual code, both bound boards, implemented profile choices, exact changed inputs,
known source limits and one consolidated defect list. Code is not a film approval. Inspect the
phone sequence before native extension and all native contact intervals afterward. Stop
optional polish when the fixed contract or bounded route sends the cut to shipment.

When the weekly recurring-defect packet is due, consider at most one reusable capability in
this same assignment. Reproduce its retained failure, write a meaningful regression and prove
the current rendered correction within the existing comparison. Record an advance or a skip
with the evidence. Preserve the daily controller's original envelope and cumulative charges.

From the effective modern-film date, read MODERN_FILM.md and STORY_ART.md. The hero and principal
supporting props come from this edition's two newly generated ImageGen assets. Use actual
board.story_art through reviewed consumers; never hard-code an earlier generated asset or
restore a primitive-kit fallback. Animate performed tasks on the global event clock. A beautiful
still slowly zoomed for an entire line is incomplete. Bind the registered episode and image
bytes, cover every story frame with purposeful shots, and show source-backed reaction and
consequence. Artwork finish and the modern engagement floor are mandatory at the creative cap.


## Capture protocol (recurring defect, October 10th, 2026)

Author source and run the cheap code checks: tsc, engine_lint, registry_check and the board gates.
Run `python scripts/native_sample_plan.py --board <current-board>` on both complete treatments
before hand-back. It calls the unchanged native sampler without rendering. Current directed
scenes need at least three distinct executable source-bound visual events; a tag or unperformed
declaration cannot supply the missing action. Preserve three distinct native samples, principal
occupancy, visible action development and all independent review gates. Discover this failure
before paying for comparison, voice or a native capture.
For editions from October 17th, verify final screen bounds after composing both `Cam` and
`PlaceSubject` transforms for every callable view, moving subject, measurement label and digit
at its event extrema. A local SVG box is insufficient after camera and ground placement.
For scale/translation constraints, solve the feasible interval from those bounds and choose
the first valid framing. Check its extrema once; avoid brute-force scale/translation grids
and repeated cosmetic changes after the bounds pass. This remains source inspection until
the separately authorized comparison; native pixels and independent reviews still decide quality.
Capture only when the current packet carries ALL of these: an actual charged render
reservation (its controller event and resource), a computed `native_headroom.py` result with the portable
housekeeping `--require-headroom --min-free-gib` pass, the invocation through
`bash scripts/run_with_env.sh`, and genuine authored art receipts recorded by
`authored_story_art.py record`. The initial packet carries none of them (`capture.allowed` is false), so the
initial builder never captures. Never render scratch placeholder entries (a `sha256` of `scratch`, a
`creation_id` that is not a real authored identity) as proof, in any props file, at any scale. This
covers `remotion still`, `remotion render`, ffmpeg encodes, preflight, cinema proof and render scripts.
On 2026-10-10 a builder ran a private native still and then a half-scale contact set outside the wrapper,
before any reservation or headroom check, against placeholder entries. Those files are retained as failures,
charged late and never used as evidence. A private batch is a procedural defect, not a faster way to look.

## Narration and picture use one clock

For new production from October 8th, every spoken clause has a narration-picture-v1 binding in board.narration_picture. Write exact clause text, concrete subject_ids, executable action_id, source claim_ids, scene_id, cue_ids and event_ids before voice production. Cover all words and qualifiers once in their original order. The registered episode declares which views actually implement those subjects and actions. A topic match, caption or label cannot replace a pictured causal step.

Before voice exists, use timing_mode authored with an explicit provisional cue plan for the silent two-treatment comparison. These estimated windows approve only planning. After alignment, board_retime.py replaces them with measured_caption_boundaries from the actual captions and acoustic word stream. Timed capture, preship and delivery require those measured inputs and reject an authored clock.

After acoustic alignment, compile every clause window from complete measured caption boundaries and the matched positional word stream. Use modern_film.compile_narration with the actual captions and words. Derive cut handoffs from silence between clauses. Only framing subdivisions inside the same subject/action may use fractions. Renderer performances consume requireNarration on the film-global clock, and retain completed consequences across cuts. Never stretch speech, scale cue times, or proportionally place a different narrated action inside a scene.

Run scripts/modern_film.py with --board, --captions, --words, --script and --claims before timed capture and preship. The gate rejects missing or duplicated clauses, omitted qualifiers, stale timing, wrong condition identity, incompatible renderer views and gaps in matching picture coverage. These checks establish bindings, not audience understanding. Code, phone and final reviewers inspect the actual subject and performed action for every clause. Return narration_picture_observations bound to the exact film, with ordered clauses containing id, pass, exact start_s/end_s and observed. Preserve a wrong or absent picture as a source/comprehension blocker even if provider metadata says pass.

A current clause must remain understandable with its captions covered. Introduce the spoken subject before its clause begins, perform the narrated change while it is heard, and retain the relevant result through the clause end. Distinguish selection, analysis, test condition, observed result and clinical limit. Generic clinical forms, a repeated test picture under an AI-selection line, or the normal condition under a patient-variant line fail this contract.

The Waymo Team
October 14, 2026
Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook
Starting today, anyone in San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa can download the Waymo app and hail a fully autonomous ride, including the San Antonio International Airport. We’ve welcomed hundreds of thousands of riders in these cities since opening our service earlier in the year, whether heading to the beach, a hockey game, the Riverwalk or just a grocery run.
While these cities have different personalities, they have similar needs. They have embraced Waymo as an important resource for expanding accessible and reliable transportation options across the region.
Speaking of options, Waymo is the newest way for people catch a flight in the Alamo City. Jesus Saenz, Director of Airports for the City of San Antonio Aviation, said: “San Antonio International Airport is committed to building the airport of the future and embracing cutting-edge technology and innovation. Waymo offering fully autonomous rides at the airport marks a significant milestone for Waymo, our city and travelers. Whether visitors are heading downtown or locals are catching an early-morning flight, they now have a new option to get there.”
In San Diego, Bob Kelly, Founder CEO of the San Diego Seniors Community Foundation, said Waymo is helping older riders do more: “Transportation is the lifeline of independence for older adults. Self-driving technology like Waymo’s isn’t just about innovation — it’s about inclusion. San Diego should be at the forefront of bringing safe, reliable, and accessible mobility options to seniors who deserve to stay active and connected.”
Over in Florida, Scott Young, Board Chair for Lighthouse for the Blind & Low Vision, said Waymo improves how his community can access more of Tampa. “For our clients, transportation is the number one barrier for their independence. A lot of them lose their sight at some point in their life or their vision decreases significantly, and they can't drive anymore. They need to rely on family members or friends or others to get you places. With Waymo, they get their independence back.”
Getting around San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa has never been easier. Simply download the Waymo app and ride today!

Waymo set to return to San Antonio after flood incidents paused service
Texas Public Radio |
By
Jerry Clayton
Published May 10, 2026 at 7:14 PM CDT
Facebook

A Waymo self-driving vehicle at Roosevelt Park ahead of the company’s rollout in San Antonio.
Sign up for TPR Today , Texas Public Radio's newsletter that brings our top stories to your inbox each morning.
Autonomous ride-hailing company Waymo is expected to resume service in San Antonio this week after suspending operations following two flood-related incidents involving its self-driving vehicles.
Operations were paused after an April 20 incident in which a Waymo vehicle was swept away by floodwaters and washed into Salado Creek. The incident came about two weeks after another Waymo vehicle became stranded in floodwaters near McCullough Avenue and Contour Drive. Both cars were unoccupied, and no one was injured in either incident.
The service pause has been the company’s longest in San Antonio to date as Waymo reviewed its flood monitoring procedures and safety protocols. Waymo previously said it would reevaluate how its vehicles respond to flood-prone areas and severe weather alerts before restarting service.
The back-to-back flood incidents also underscored how quickly changing weather conditions in San Antonio can challenge autonomous vehicle technology.
Waymo’s rollout in San Antonio has also raised broader questions about how self-driving vehicles interact with emergency responders during severe weather and other emergencies.
Waymo began operations in San Antonio in February in a limited service area covering 60 square miles of the city. The company also operates in 11 other cities around the country, including Austin, Dallas and Houston.
